name: dst_2c_check
description: Short DST functional check, staircase rescaled so its peak step is exactly 2C
comment: profile_peak_c_rate normalizes the staircase to its own peak (-1.0) and rescales that to 2C = 3.800 A for LP604765 -- exactly the cell's max_discharge_a. 3 repeats x 92 s ~= 4.6 min, removing only ~0.09 Ah (~5% SOC). Raise repeat for a real run.
